profiles.name: FinPro
profiles.description: Banking analytics and financial consulting platform used to review risk, solvency, and financial performance dashboards.

pages.name: Solvency Intelligence
pages.purpose: Help users understand current solvency health, risk drivers, and recommended actions.
pages.main_job: Review solvency score changes and understand what actions should be taken next.
known_friction: Users may not understand why the score changed
Executives need summary first, details second
Financial thresholds must be visually clear
design_notes: Start with high-level KPI cards before detailed charts or tables
Always explain score movement with plain-language drivers
Use clear thresholds for high, moderate, and low risk

pages.name: Loan Analytics Dashboard
pages.purpose: Help users review loan portfolio performance, risk exposure, and trends.
pages.main_job: Identify portfolio risk and performance issues quickly.
known_friction: Large data tables can overwhelm users
Users need context before seeing detailed loan rows
design_notes: Use KPI cards as the first section
Place detailed tables below summary and trend sections
Support filtering by risk level and portfolio segment

pages.name: FinPropedia
pages.purpose: Help users find, manage, and export official financial framework content.
pages.main_job: Find official financial definitions and export them into presentation-ready content.
known_friction: Users may struggle to find the correct framework definition
Exported content must preserve formatting
Large topic trees can become hard to navigate
design_notes: Prioritize search and scannable topic navigation
Keep selected export content visible
Make PowerPoint export status clear

ux_constraints: Financial numbers must be clear and trustworthy
Users need to understand why scores changed

profiles.name: Wealth Wing
profiles.description: Personal finance app for tracking accounts, imports, transactions, categories, and recurring subscriptions.

pages.name: Dashboard
pages.purpose: Give users a quick overview of financial health, spending, subscriptions, and recent activity.
pages.main_job: Understand current financial status without digging through transactions first.
known_friction: Users may not understand what changed month over month
Too many charts can make the dashboard feel noisy
design_notes: Show KPI cards first
Place detailed transaction table below summary sections
Use plain-language insights for changes in spending

pages.name: Accounts
pages.purpose: Let users view and manage financial accounts.
pages.main_job: Understand where money is stored and whether account data is accurate.
known_friction: Users may not understand account status
Inactive accounts can clutter the page
design_notes: Show account type, institution, balance, and status clearly
Separate active and archived accounts

pages.name: Imports
pages.purpose: Let users upload, map, review, and process transaction imports.
pages.main_job: Import transactions accurately without creating duplicates.
known_friction: Users may worry about duplicate transactions
Column mapping can be confusing
Failed imports need clear recovery steps
design_notes: Use a step-by-step flow
Show validation before final import
Make duplicate detection visible

pages.name: Transactions
pages.purpose: Let users search, filter, review, and categorize transactions.
pages.main_job: Find and understand spending activity quickly.
known_friction: Large transaction lists can become hard to scan
Users may need quick category corrections
design_notes: Keep filters visible and easy to reset
Use readable amount formatting
Separate income and expenses visually but subtly

pages.name: Subscriptions
pages.purpose: Help users detect and review recurring charges.
pages.main_job: Identify recurring payments and understand monthly subscription cost.
known_friction: Detection may produce false positives
Users need to trust why something was marked as recurring
design_notes: Explain why a subscription was detected
Show related transaction history
Allow users to confirm or dismiss detected subscriptions

ux_constraints: Financial data should be easy to scan
Users need confidence that imports are accurate
Charts should explain trends without overwhelming the user

profiles.name: MedTrack
profiles.description: Healthcare operations platform for tracking patient intake, appointments, staff workflows, and clinic performance.

pages.name: Clinic Dashboard
pages.purpose: Help clinic teams understand current operational status and workload.
pages.main_job: Identify patient flow bottlenecks and staff workload issues.
known_friction: Busy users need fast scanning
Critical patient status should be visible quickly
design_notes: Use clear status hierarchy
Avoid dense dashboards
Prioritize urgent operational issues

ux_constraints: Must reduce cognitive load for busy staff
Critical patient status should be visible quickly

profiles.name: RetailPulse
profiles.description: Retail analytics dashboard for monitoring sales performance, inventory movement, customer trends, and store operations.

pages.name: Sales Dashboard
pages.purpose: Help retail teams monitor sales performance and identify changes quickly.
pages.main_job: Understand sales performance across time periods and locations.
known_friction: Users need fast comparison between stores
Too many metrics can distract from daily decisions
design_notes: Show KPI cards first
Use comparison views for stores and periods
Make underperforming products easy to find

ux_constraints: KPIs should support fast daily decisions
Users need comparison between stores and time periods
Inventory risks should be visually obvious
Mobile-friendly summaries may be needed for managers
